headline.head: JUST SURVIVED. NOW SHOPPING.
headline.sub: Sergio's empty WR slot saved the commish by 3.6. Two days later the commish went shopping in Sergio's old roster. Flowers were not sent.

jabs.flop: Even the commissioner's own waiver claims refuse to start for him.
jabs.benched: Overpaid in Week 2, under-started in Week 4. Vladimir Tuten contains multitudes.
jabs.lowball: Four managers valued Vele between $26 and $62. maruniak offered bus fare.
jabs.steal: Found twelve free points and parked them on the bench. Half a genius.

paper.obituary: Started an empty slot. Left $1,000 unspent. Survived by a fully furnished bench.

jokes.text: 🚨 Sources: the commish survived by 3.6 because Sergio never set a lineup, then spent $318 on Sergio's TE and WR. The league office investigated itself and found no wrongdoing.

jokes.premise: Kittle bid as a thank-you card
jokes.text: Kittle went for $222 when the next bid was $118. That's not a waiver claim. That's a thank-you card.
He also put in claims on Swift and Harvey. Four of Sergio's starters in one night. Not tampering. Just a very specific shopping list.
jackmccarthy25 paid $59 for Jalen Coker, the 0.0 that ended the last owner. Coker is on bye this week. Cursed object.

jokes.premise: five moves, zero starts, film don't lie
jokes.text: Five moves on Monday. Zero of them in the lineup. An empty WR slot, a late-scratch Coker at 0.0, and Gainwell's 10.7 rotting on the bench. Start Gainwell and Sergio lives at 98.1. Film don't lie.
$48 for Dallas Goedert. 0.0 points. From the bench. Not even a decoy.
Vladimir Tuten paid $62 for Devaughn Vele, benched him, watched 17.4 hit the pine. Scouting department: elite. Head coach: fired.
BDALOHA left 28.1 on the bench, one week after benching a $299 Pollard. That's not a pattern anymore. That's a scheme.

jokes.premise: ball don't lie, one dollar each way
jokes.text: maruniak lost Waddle by $1, then won Swift by $1. Ball don't lie.
matthewmongelli finally spent $70 and is still sitting on $930 with a 10th-place team. It's FAAB, not a 401(k). There is no match.
jackmccarthy25: 2nd in points, $941 untouched. Either iron discipline or he thinks FAAB is a gift card.
Maye Defenders finally ate: 27.16, three TDs, a W in Buffalo. Nix Believers point at the season total (60.26 to 54.76) and Maye's 7 INTs. The discourse remains undefeated.
The Browns are 3-1 and first in the AFC North off a 56-yard walk-off. Cleveland is cautiously terrified.
Watson reportedly found a new masseuse in town. No further questions.

comic.text: Sergio made five moves on Monday.
Did he start any of them?
Then bought Sergio's tight end for $222. Normal league.
